title: DOER-2: parked needs-code backlog items reach a code route
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every tick that parks an item with blocker needs-code:
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/doer.js::needs-code route
**Status:** closed

DOER-1 (#344) makes every D1 dispatch end done, parked or waiting. Items the Workers AI triage marks needs_code (for example SG-2) are parked with a reason and a first step, but nothing turns them into a change: the Worker-native executor (seed/worker/src/nativeexec.js) reads docs/issues/*.json, not the D1 items table, and the tick has no GitHub token bound (EXEC-SPARK-UNREACHABLE). Build the bridge: when a GitHub token is available, the doer opens one worker/<item> PR per parked needs-code item through runNative's path guard (or mirrors the item into docs/issues/), and records the PR on the item; without a token, the D1 store stays the queue and the count of parked needs-code items is published on /health.

size: M

**Closing probe:** GET https://ultrastable-tick.q08.workers.dev/health shows needs_code_parked and a worker/* PR exists for at least one parked item

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 171.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
